subject: Approval: CloudSpark SLA amendment & service-credit schedule
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>; Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SLA amendment & credit schedule for CloudSpark - RWI-3245

Hi Laura / Vivek —

Quick context: CloudSpark (prospect -> pilot) is asking for two non-standard items as part of their committed Dedicated contract:

1) Uptime SLO: 99.95% -> they want 99.99% across a cross-region private deployment.
2) Service-credit schedule: they want credits to be unlimited / uncapped for sustained partial outages.

We have a strong AD baseline; CloudSpark is asking for these as a condition for a multi-year commit (~$2.1M ARR commitment over 3 years). Sales rationale: they have strict regulatory SLAs and will be onboarding 3 internal teams in Q4 — high strategic value.

Attached is the latest SLA redline from the customer (SLA_redline_v2.pdf) and our proposed MOPs diagram. I recommend we consider a constrained exception: approve a 99.99% latency/availability objective for the primary region only, require cross-region fallback to remain at 99.95%, and set a capped credit schedule tied to monthly spend (max 20% of monthly invoice).

Asking for:
- Deal Desk / Exec approval for the above SLO exception + capped credit schedule
- If approved, authorize legal to proceed with a redline that reflects the cap and the region-limited SLO

Next step: would appreciate a quick yes/no/conditions from Vivek today so we can keep momentum with CloudSpark (they expect a response by EOD PST).

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com

Attachments: SLA_redline_v2.pdf (pdf, 342KB), MOPs-architecture-diagram.png (png, 88KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>; Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jun 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SLA amendment & credit schedule for CloudSpark - RWI-3245

Jordan —

Thanks for the summary and attachments. A few clarifying Qs before I escalate to Legal:

1) Is the 99.99% ask for availability or for latency P99/P95? The redline mixes availability and latency obligations; need to be explicit.
2) What is the expected monthly spend during pilot vs committed year 1? (we need that to size the credit cap)
3) Any special compliance needs (SOC2 + FedRAMP? customer mentioned regulatory constraints) — if FedRAMP, that changes risk.

My initial read: I'm comfortable proceeding with a conditional exception if we:
- Limit the 99.99% requirement to the primary region only, with a fallback SLO of 99.95% cross-region.
- Cap total credits at 20% of monthly invoice and include a per-incident cap of 5% of monthly invoice.
- Require an operational runbook and quarterly ops review for the first 12 months (op to be provided by Jordan / CloudSpark).

Please reply with the numbers for monthly spend and whether the ask is availability vs latency so I can put a concise ask to Vivek + Legal.

- Laura
Laura Bennett
Head, Deal Desk | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Request: SLA amendment & credit schedule for CloudSpark - RWI-3245

Laura — thanks. Quick answers inline: 

1) Customer is requesting "99.99% availability" specifically (they referenced platform uptime, not P99 latency).
2) Pilot spend estimate: ~$30k/month for 2 months. Year 1 committed run-rate projected: ~$58k/month (they commit to usage growth ramp).
3) Compliance: SOC 2 required; FedRAMP not required. They will sign our SOC2 attestation and provide evidence on request.

Jordan

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>; Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Jun 2025 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: APPROVED (conditional): CloudSpark SLA exception — RWI-3245

Team —

I reviewed the ask and the proposed mitigations. I approve a constrained SLA exception for CloudSpark with the following mandatory conditions:

- Approved SLOs:
  * Primary region availability: 99.99% (monthly measurement)
  * Cross-region/failover baseline: 99.95%

- Service-credit schedule (required, enforceable):
  * Per-incident credit: up to 5% of monthly invoice for qualifying partial outages
  * Monthly aggregate cap: 20% of monthly invoice
  * Credits expire if monthly invoice < $10k (i.e., no credits for months under $10k)

- Operational controls:
  * Customer must provide a runbook and notify Redwood NOC for any planned maintenance impacting SLOs
  * Quarterly ops review for the first 12 months (owner: Monica Patel)

- Commercial concessions:
  * Approve one-time onboarding discount of 10% on year-one invoices (applied to month 1-3) in lieu of unlimited credits
  * Net-new customers only; no retrospective application to existing contracts

- Legal / Contracts:
  * Laura, please prepare the redline reflecting these bullets and route to CloudSpark legal (legal@cloudspark.com). Include DocuSign link (https://www.docusign.com/en/link/abc123-sign).

I want to limit precedent risk: please mark this as a "cust-conditional-exception" in HubSpot and attach the final signed SLA as a legal artifact.

Approved by: Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Commercial & Partnerships | Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com

---
Forwarded message included above.
